summary: Stripe Billing Integration and Super Admin Stats tested successfully. All backend APIs working (9/9 tests passed). Frontend BillingSection and Super Admin dashboard verified working correctly.

issues: Console shows 'Failed to fetch inventory: AxiosError' - inventory endpoint returns 404 (unrelated to billing feature)

GET_api_super_admin_stats.details: Returns correct organization count: 18 total, 18 active, 0 suspended. Bug fix verified - organizations without 'status' field are now counted as 'active'.

GET_api_org_billing.details: Returns subscription info (Starter plan), plan details, billing cycle (monthly), status (active), next renewal date.

GET_api_org_plans.details: Returns 3 plans: Starter ($0), Professional ($49/mo), Enterprise ($149/mo) with correct limits and features.

POST_api_org_billing_checkout.details: Creates valid Stripe checkout session with real checkout.stripe.com URL and session_id starting with 'cs_test_'.

POST_api_org_billing_checkout_free_plan.details: Returns 400 error for free plan checkout as expected - 'Free plans don't require payment'.

GET_api_org_billing_checkout_status.details: Returns transaction status for valid session_id. Returns 404 for invalid session.

frontend_billing_section.details: Shows Current Plan (Starter), Price ($0/mo), Cycle (Monthly), Next Renewal, Status (Active), Change Plan button, Monthly Usage bars.

frontend_upgrade_dialog.details: Shows 3 plans with Monthly/Yearly toggle, Save 17% badge, correct pricing ($0, $49, $149), Pay & Upgrade buttons for paid plans.

frontend_super_admin_dashboard.details: Shows 18 Total Organizations, 18 Active Organizations (bug fix verified), 19 Total Users, Organization Status breakdown.

critical_code_review_comments: Inventory endpoint returns 404 - unrelated to billing but shows in console logs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe billing integration fully implemented with REAL Stripe checkout (not mocked). Uses emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout module with test key sk_test_emergent. Checkout creates real Stripe sessions that redirect to checkout.stripe.com. super_admin_stats.returns: organizations (total, active, suspended), subscriptions_by_plan, total_users, events_this_month
